verdict.rationale: Multiple documentation citations point directly to a machine-readable OpenAPI YAML spec at https://apidocs.anrok.com/openapi.yaml, which underlies the developer docs (customer, product, tax ID, filing endpoints etc.), indicating a downloadable OpenAPI spec exists. Missing for 10: independent probe confirmation that the .yaml file resolves (only .json/.well-known variants were tested and 404'd), and no explicit 'download spec' UI mention.
